sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders come into the fixture off the back of a loss but remain in strong form overall, with seven wins from their last six outings. Alsager sit bottom of the division with just four points and are winless in their last five matches, making this a favourable opportunity for Sandbach to bounce back.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second-placed and just two points behind Sandbach, travel to Dawley Town in what could be a crucial fixture in the title race. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, host Eccleshall—a side in good recent form with four wins in their last six—in a compelling mid-table encounter. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, face Wednesfield Community at home in a battle between sides on contrasting form. Bilston Town's visit to Foley Meir sees two mid-table sides square off, while Barnton—unbeaten in their last two—host Shawbury United, who are in freefall with six consecutive losses. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a clash of inconsistent sides, Crewe face Allscott Heath, and Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in the basement battle. Brereton Social complete the fixture list at home to Widnes Town, who sit bottom with just two points.
